title: Nine Miles of Opening
subtitle: 诊所与门诊 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 诊所与门诊（科学与技术·医学与健康科学）
meta: 主题语境：诊所与门诊（科学与技术·医学与健康科学）　|　核心词汇：clinic　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 clinic 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 my mother was sent to open ① clinic she could not staff, and she said the opening was the whole of the lesson. The ② clinic, meaning the building and not the treatment, was nine miles away and was opened by whoever came last; clinic, she said, is the only thing in a district that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ clinic in that district had the same queue, and the ④ clinic at the end, meaning the one the doctor kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever opened properly. Clinic, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ clinic was the whole of the winter, meaning the care it carried and not the building. The ⑥ clinic, meaning the care and not any of that, is the only thing in a winter that everybody needs and nobody questions; clinic, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a building and care. She said the care is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ clinic had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the queue. The ⑧ clinic of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine miles and eleven years of opening; clinic, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ clinic I remember is the one at the end, which was opened in 1975 and is still described as the busiest in the county. A ⑩ clinic, my grandmother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being opened; every clinic, she said, is care that has agreed to look like a building. She said the care was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 诊所（指那处房子本身，与那次诊疗相对）
C. 固定搭配：open a clinic 开办一家诊所
D. n. 诊所（指那个区里每一家）
E. n. 诊所（指末尾那一家）
F. n. 诊护（抽象：它承载的那份照护）
G. n. 那份照护（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The clinic, meaning the building and not the treatment
clinic was the whole of the winter
the clinic had become a number in a report
The clinic of the whole thing
A clinic, my grandmother said in 1980

answers.why: open a clinic 意为“开办一家诊所”，1955 年母亲被派去开办她配不齐人手的那家诊所。
clinic 意为“诊所、门诊部”，指那处房子本身而不是那次诊疗，在九英里外，由最后来的人开办。
clinic 指那个区里每一家诊所，每一家都是同样的队伍。
clinic 指末尾那一家（医生留下的那一家），是唯一有人认真开办过的。
clinic 意为“诊护”，抽象指它承载的那份照护，父亲说 clinic 就是那个冬天的全部。
clinic 为抽象用法，指那份照护本身，是一个冬天里人人都需要、却没人质疑的东西。
clinic 意为“诊所、门诊部”，到 1970 年这家 clinic 成了报告里的一个数字。
clinic 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英里和十一年的开办。
clinic 意为“诊所”，我记得的是末尾那一家，1975 年开办，至今仍被说成全县最忙的。
clinic 为抽象总称，祖母说一家诊所是唯一会因为被认真开办而变好的东西。
